name: USS Hornet (CV-8), Midway1942
axes: right-handed: X bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
configuration: June1942 Yorktown-class exterior: three centerline elevators, starboard island and integral single funnel, eight single 5-inch/38 guns and four quadruple 1.1-inch mounts. Individual radar and bridge variants are stored separately.
accuracy: Independently authored detailed exterior reconstruction for the June1942 demonstration. Major class configuration is source-backed. Hull body sections, small station offsets, doors, rails and plating are inferred original artwork. Not a recovered shipyard model and not a claim that every small AA fitting or paint patch is exact. One stored GLB supplies every view; no interior is modeled.
geometrySource: New class-specific full exterior and station ledger. No campaign carrier mesh or previous vertex buffer is reused.

sources.title: FM30-50 (1941), printed pages39-42, Enterprise-Hornet-Yorktown paired plan/profile
sources.license: Factual reference only; original mesh and surface detail. Source illustration not redistributed or traced.
sources.usedFor: Class island/funnel massing, three centerline elevators, low side batteries and flight-deck supports. 1942 radar fits are separately dated.

sources.license: Factual reference only; original mesh and surface detail. Source illustration not redistributed or traced.
sources.usedFor: Hornet only received CXAM June20-28 and a fifth 1.1-inch mount in July; neither later change is used for the Midway model.

dimensionBasis: NHHC DANFS as-built length 246.8118 m and hull beam25.3238 m. Flight-deck width28m is an inferred usable-deck width inside the published34.7472m overall width including projections. No 1943 Enterprise blisters are fitted.
layoutProvenance: New 1942 demo-specific authoring record, independent of early-conversion campaign assets.

fitReview.status: Dated exterior reconstruction; major features reviewed, small fittings inferred
fitReview.stationAxes: x bow-positive; y starboard-positive; z above waterline, metres
notes: Early-war as-built hull dimensions follow NHHC rather than the later 827ft4in wartime Enterprise overall figure. Usable deck width and small mount stations are inferred within the documented projection envelope.

Twenty 20mm exterior positions represent the early-war light-AA appearance; small wartime additions differed among sisters and are not claimed as an exact station survey. No post-1942 Bofors or Enterprise bulges are included.
Midway Hornet: taller individual bridge and small SC-1 array. The later CXAM bedspring, fifth quad mount and catapult removal are excluded.
